reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes delegating digital assets to an automated arbitrage system while claiming monthly profit allocations of approximately 6% to 18% and that entrusted assets are unaffected by price fluctuations. It also links sharing the opportunity and expanding referral layers to cryptocurrency commissions, with a sponsor-code request presented as a participation step. the available video evidence does not establish that transfers occurred, returns were achieved, or the claims were independently verified.

citations.quote: You can delegate any arbitrage. Intelligent Dog will be good to your part in the arbitrage profit About 6% to 18% of the monthly profit allocation to your wallet
On the second to tenth layers, you can still take 10% of their smart gains.
You can get the first layer, that is the friend you share directly, with 100% of intellectual benefits.
In order to protect the asset security of the user Plus Token You must keep a private key

opening.argument: The presentation includes risk-aware language rather than an unconditional promise. It expressly identifies the “risks of artificial arbitrage,” explains that users may pause the automated system, and says the entrusted asset and benefits will be transferred back to the wallet. That framing is consistent with explaining a technology and its operating controls, while leaving the viewer to assess whether the claimed strategy is suitable. The material therefore can be read as a qualified presentation of a tool, not a deceptive guarantee of profit.

citations.quote: Of course, you can also pause your smart dog at any time The asset and smart benefits you trust will be transferred to your wallet in a timely fashion.
In order to protect the asset security of the user Plus Token You must keep a private key

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the profit range as a guarantee, but the presentation also discusses the risks of artificial arbitrage and describes a pause function. Its statement about a private key addresses asset security, not a request to surrender credentials. Referral language may describe an incentive, but it does not establish deception or that any payment occurred.

citations.quote: Of course, you can also pause your smart dog at any time The asset and smart benefits you trust will be transferred to your wallet in a timely fashion.
In order to protect the asset security of the user Plus Token You must keep a private key

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A risk illustration does not qualify the central income pitch: the speaker still says users receive “About 6% to 18%” monthly, while describing entrusted assets as unaffected by price fluctuations. A pause feature and private-key language do not show that the claimed returns are conditional, independently verified, or safe.

citations.quote: About 6% to 18% of the monthly profit allocation to your wallet
The digital assets entrusted by users are completely unaffected by price fluctuations

opening.argument: The content is structured as an explanation of how a digital-asset wallet, exchange, and arbitrage robot are supposed to operate. It identifies the wallet's storage and settlement functions, explains that the robot compares prices and volumes across trading platforms, and describes several arbitrage modes. The accompanying frames are instructional diagrams, including a robot beside the explanation of price differences and a chart illustrating artificial-arbitrage risk. This supports treating the video as technology education or an operational demonstration, rather than proof that viewers must invest.

citations.quote: PlusToken 3.0 version is both the decentralized digital asset wallet and a decentralized trading platform
the robot will identify and capture the differents price and volume of the Digital Assets on each trading platform
including hedging arbitrage, currency arbitrage transaction and quantitative transaction of digital assets.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The fact that a video explains a product does not make it a scam solicitation. The content focuses on architecture, storage, settlement, and the mechanics of automated arbitrage. The robot graphic and risk chart are consistent with a product demonstration, and the prosecution supplies no evidence that the video documents an actual transfer or outcome.

citations.quote: PlusToken 3.0 version is both the decentralized digital asset wallet and a decentralized trading platform
the robot will identify and capture the differents price and volume of the Digital Assets on each trading platform

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The technical vocabulary is packaging for a solicitation, not neutral instruction. The speaker moves from describing the robot to telling viewers they can delegate assets and receive monthly allocations, then explains earnings from sharing with multiple layers. A diagram can illustrate a claimed scheme without proving the system works or making the promotion educational.

citations.quote: You can delegate any arbitrage. Intelligent Dog will be good to your part in the arbitrage profit About 6% to 18% of the monthly profit allocation to your wallet
You can get the first layer, that is the friend you share directly, with 100% of intellectual benefits.
On the second to tenth layers, you can still take 10% of their smart gains.

opening.argument: On the supplied record, this is a promotion for a digital-asset wallet and associated service. The title calls it “Latest online crypto wallet technology,” and the description asks for a sponsor or recommendation code. That is compatible with ordinary product promotion and referral marketing. The material does not show a completed deposit, a credential request, a verified payout, or an actual user outcome. Even the numerical examples are presented as illustrations of a referral calculation, including “For example,” rather than evidence that anyone received those sums.

citations.quote: Plus Token wallet Latest online crypto wallet technology
Sponsor number/recommend code: 205117837 (require to fill. Thanks)
For example, he commissioned .5 Bitcoins, his smart income this month, was calculated at an average of 10% and he got .5 Bitcoins.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The product description and sponsor-code request support ordinary commerce with a referral component, not necessarily fraud. The prosecution's quoted commission structure describes how an incentive would be calculated, but does not establish that viewers deposited funds, that the presenter took money, or that the examples were reported as completed outcomes. The record therefore lacks the mechanism needed to classify the promotion as deceptive.

citations.quote: Plus Token wallet Latest online crypto wallet technology
Sponsor number/recommend code: 205117837 (require to fill. Thanks)
For example, he commissioned .5 Bitcoins, his smart income this month, was calculated at an average of 10% and he got .5 Bitcoins.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the offer a wallet service does not neutralize its specific mechanism. The speaker says users delegate assets to an automated arbitrage system for monthly profit and earn from first through tenth referral layers. The absence of a completed transfer is not exculpatory: the video itself presents the invitation, proposed returns, and sponsor-code step without independent verification.
